description: Guided learning tour of the Julia programming language codebase. Covers runtime, compiler, frontend, base library, and standard libraries.

nodes.title: Start Here: Process Entry Point
nodes.description: The main() function starts here. It initializes the loader, finds libjulia, and jumps into jl_main(). This is where the Julia process begins execution.

nodes.title: Dynamic Loader & Library Discovery
nodes.description: Loader finds and loads libjulia.so/.dll, resolves symbols, and sets up trampolines for C API exports. Cross-platform (Linux/macOS/Windows).

nodes.title: C API Trampolines & Exports
nodes.description: Generated trampolines export Julia's C API (jl_* functions) from the shared library. Symbol stripping controls public vs private exports.

nodes.title: Runtime Core: Types, GC, Threading
nodes.description: Core runtime definitions: jl_value_t type hierarchy, garbage collector API, threading model, fast thread-local storage, locks. Everything builds on this.

nodes.title: JIT Compilation & LLVM Codegen
nodes.description: JIT layer manages LLVM contexts, compiles Julia IR to machine code, runs optimization passes, caches compiled objects. LLVM version abstraction handles compatibility.

nodes.title: Builtins & Compiler Intrinsics
nodes.description: C prototypes for builtin functions (Core.Intrinsics) and compiler intrinsics that lower directly to LLVM IR. Bridge between runtime and compiler.

nodes.title: Support Library: Hashing, I/O, Platform
nodes.description: Low-level utilities: pointer/string hashing, I/O streams, platform abstraction, time parsing. Used throughout runtime.

nodes.title: Compiler Layer (Compiler.jl) — Written in Julia
nodes.description: The compiler is a separate Julia module (Compiler.jl). Handles type inference, SSA IR (Core.Compiler), optimizations, codegen. Can be swapped independently. See Compiler/ directory.

nodes.title: Frontend: Parser & Lowering (JuliaSyntax, JuliaLowering)
nodes.description: Modern parser (JuliaSyntax.jl) produces lossless CST. JuliaLowering lowers to compiler IR (HIR). Both written in Julia, in base/ and stdlib/.

nodes.title: Base Library — Core Standard Library
nodes.description: Loaded at startup. Fundamental types (Int, Float, Array, Tuple, Dict), I/O, math, reflection, exceptions, tasks, multi-threading primitives. All Julia code.

nodes.title: Standard Library Packages
nodes.description: Independent packages (Pkg, REPL, LinearAlgebra, Random, Sockets, etc.). Each has own version, loaded on demand via `using`. See stdlib/ directory.

nodes.title: Build System & Tooling
nodes.description: Make-based build. Make.user for local config. deps/ for external dependencies (LLVM, libuv, etc.). CI in GitHub Actions. Build outputs to usr/.

nodes.title: Documentation
nodes.description: User manual, developer docs, API reference. Built with Documenter.jl. Source in doc/src/. Key: doc/src/devdocs/ for contributor guides.

nodes.title: Test Suite
nodes.description: Runtime tests (test/), base tests (base/test/), stdlib tests. Run with `make test` or `./julia test/runtests.jl`. Use JULIA_TEST_FAILFAST=1 for quick feedback.
